{"command":"cat > /tmp/make_sbom.py <<'EOF'
import hashlib, json, os, datetime

SPDX = "https://spdx.org/spdxdocs/trustdemo-0.1.0-"

def sha1(path):
    return hashlib.sha1(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()

def sha256(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()

wheel = "/tmp/sbomsrc/dist/trustdemo-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl"

# wheel member files
import zipfile
z = zipfile.ZipFile(wheel)
members = sorted(n for n in z.namelist() if not n.endswith("/"))

# extract with deterministic mtimes for hashing consistency (hashes are content-only anyway)
files = []
for i, name in enumerate(members):
    data = z.read(name)
    tmp = os.path.join("/tmp/wheelx", name)
    files.append({
        "fileName": "./" + name,
        "SPDXID": f"SPDXRef-File-w{i}",
        "checksums": [
            {"algorithm": "SHA1", "checksumValue": hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()},
            {"algorithm": "SHA256", "checksumValue": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()},
        ],
        "licenseConcluded": "NOASSERTION",
        "licenseInfoInFiles": ["NOASSERTION"],
        "copyrightText": "NOASSERTION",
    })

wheel_checksums = [
    {"algorithm": "SHA1", "checksumValue": sha1(wheel)},
    {"algorithm": "SHA256", "checksumValue": sha256(wheel)},
]

# source files from the frozen manifest (same content as wheel's trustdemo/)
sources = []
for manifest_line in open("/home/agent/workspace/SOURCE_FREEZE.txt"):
    if manifest_line.startswith("#") or not manifest_line.strip():
        continue
    _, size, path = manifest_line.split()
    full = os.path.join("/home/agent/workspace", path)
    data = open(full, "rb").read()
    sources.append({
        "fileName": "./" + path,
        "SPDXID": f"SPDXRef-File-src-{len(sources)}",
        "checksums": [
            {"algorithm": "SHA1", "checksumValue": hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()},
            {"algorithm": "SHA256", "checksumValue": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()},
        ],
        "licenseConcluded": "NOASSERTION",
        "licenseInfoInFiles": ["NOASSERTION"],
        "copyrightText": "NOASSERTION",
    })

all_files = sources + files

doc = {
    "spdxVersion": "SPDX-2.3",
    "dataLicense": "CC0-1.0",
    "SPDXID": "SPDXRef-DOCUMENT",
    "name": "trustdemo-0.1.0-SBOM",
    "documentNamespace": SPDX + datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S"),
    "creationInfo": {
        "created": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        "creators": ["Tool: manual-sbom-generator-1.0"],
        "licenseListVersion": "3.25",
    },
    "packages": [
        {
            "name": "trustdemo",
            "SPDXID": "SPDXRef-Package-trustdemo",
            "versionInfo": "0.1.0",
            "supplier": "Organization: NOASSERTION",
            "originator": "NOASSERTION",
            "downloadLocation": "NOASSERTION",
            "filesAnalyzed": True,
            "checksums": wheel_checksums,
            "licenseConcluded": "NOASSERTION",
            "licenseInfoFromFiles": ["NOASSERTION"],
            "licenseDeclared": "NOASSERTION",
            "copyrightText": "NOASSERTION",
            "primaryPackagePurpose": "LIBRARY",
            "externalRefs": [
                {
                    "referenceCategory": "PACKAGE-MANAGER",
                    "referenceType": "purl",
                    "referenceLocator": "pkg:pypi/trustdemo@0.1.0",
                }
            ],
            "hasFiles": [f["SPDXID"] for f in files],
        }
    ],
    "files": all_files,
    "relationships": [
        {
            "spdxElementId": "SPDXRef-DOCUMENT",
            "relationshipType": "DESCRIBES",
            "relatedSpdxElement": "SPDXRef-Package-trustdemo",
        },
        {
            "spdxElementId": "SPDXRef-Package-trustdemo",
            "relationshipType": "CONTAINS",
            "relatedSpdxElement": f["SPDXID"],
        } for f in files
    ],
}

with open("/home/agent/workspace/trustdemo.spdx.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(doc, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    f.write("\n")
print("wrote SBOM with", len(all_files), "files")
EOF
python /tmp/make_sbom.py"}

raw = json.load(open("/home/agent/workspace/trustdemo.spdx.json"))
